entities.summary: Andrii Viktorovych Hnatov is a Ukrainian Marine Corps major general who has been the Chief of the General Staff of the Armed Forces of Ukraine since 2025. He was previously the Commander of the Joint Forces of the Armed Forces of Ukraine from 2024 to 2025. Member of the Headquarters of the Supreme Commander-in-Chief since 28 March 2025.
